text: Hello, this is our hiring assistant demo. You can click through the whole process. A person applies, HR reveals them and a person makes the final years or no. Two rows here. Job seekers and HR use different screens. The interview rounds offline and on local computers. Data states inside a country. The four cards show what we care about. Local data offline interview, English and Arabic. HR makes the final call. This slide shows if we are online or offline. Green is connected and yellow means offline. We start on the job seekers side. They are logging in and upload a CV. The system reads name, email works history and other fields. Green means okay, yellow means please check and red means missing. Click evidence to see where each value came from in the CV. And you need to confirm the fields and press submit. Next is CV update. If they upload a new CV, we show old and new side by side. Chain fields are highlighted. They must press accepted. This is an online test. Questions show in the English and Arabic. They pick answers and submit. The score appears right away. They can see which answers were wrong. They only see their own scores. This is the AI interview. First is English. The avatar asks a follow up. Then Arabic then submit. HR gets the recording and the job seekers does not. The photo and text on the left are settings. The real system will use voice and moving lips. Job seekers never see their rank or other people in the pool. They can see their match score and status. They cannot hire or reject anyone. Okay, we leave and open the HR side. And now this is the HR dashboard. HR uses different logging and different screens. Here we see six people ranked by fit. We can filter by scale, years and degree. We can export to Excel. Click score to see what. Okay, we see service at 98% because we can point you lines in their CV. Not a hidden number. To move someone forward, HR most type of reason, press short list. HR can watch the interview again. Photo, text and full chat in English and Arabic. Press play or click one line to drop. Job seekers cannot open this page definitely. And last step is hire or reject. The screen shows an AI suggestion. HR picks hire or reject. He also needs to write why and confirms. The system does not hire anyone by itself. This table lists who did what and when we can export it to a file. The bottom page sum up the demo. Two separate screens, clear scores and human decisions. And also the two languages. And so that's the full demo. The real products will connect to Jadeira around local AI and use a live avatar. Thank you.
